snippet.title: Scary Baboon - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the launch trailer for Scary Baboon, A game where you take place in a laboratory and have to survive what waits, communicate with you fellow baboons to make up and plan to escape the monsters, Scary Baboon is available now for Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3, Meta Quest 3S, and Meta Quest Pro. 



Music used: https://youtu.be/J-MxMAhh5hw?si=BhPsCMIY5uXa8Isk
